headline: Everything BSP_Game_OnMove (004e4a40) runs between the last simulation call and BSP_Game_Render (004ca440): the particle clock, the foliage impostor build, the GUI visibility policy, the queued sound cue and the front-end screen update, followed by the profiled render block.

source_of_truth.onmove_body: Ghidra stores an eight-byte body for 004e4a40; the window was read with `python tools/bsp.py disasm-raw 004e4a40 --length 2808` into local/onmove.txt.

frame_order.condition: the simulation gate at 004e50b0 was taken
the gate was not taken; the two paths join at 004e53bb

dead_render_gate.finding: The slot is written 0 at 004e548a on both incoming paths (the loop exit at 004e5488 falls through, and 004e5453 jumps there) and nothing between takes its address: 004c1b90, 00941140, 004d8620 and 004c1dd0 take no pointer to it and 00be3660 restores esp. The jump is never taken, so BSP_Game_Render always runs on this path.
dead_render_gate.handling: reproduced in bsp::run_render_tail because it is in the binary

functions.name: BSP_ParticleClock_GetSingleton
functions.behavior: Double-checked lazy singleton over DAT_00f8d420 under BSP_SingletonLifetime_GetManager()+10h. Allocates 1Ch bytes via 00bf681b, stores PTR_..._00ce7d38 at +0 and PTR_LAB_00ce7d24 at +4, zeroes +8h..+14h, registers with BSP_SingletonLifetime_Register.

functions.name: BSP_ParticleClock_SetFrameTime
functions.behavior: Stores the float at this+18h, then walks records at this+8h with count this+0Ch and stride 2Ch, calling (*(void**)(record+28h))->vtable[18h](float). The end bound is recomputed each iteration from +8h and +0Ch while the cursor advances from the old base.
functions.argument: the global time in milliseconds, not a delta: 00ce47a0 holds the double 1000.0 (bytes 00 00 00 00 00 40 8F 40) and 00f876a4 is the global time float written only by 00874640
functions.cross_check: docs/SHADER_CONSTANT_DISPATCH_ANALYSIS.md line 67 takes component y of shader constant c33 'Time' from 004de4b0() result+18h, the field this call writes

functions.name: BSP_FoliageGroups_SetShaderTime
functions.behavior: Twelve bytes: MOV [ECX+2Ch],arg; RET 4. The getter at 00af0460 is FLD [ECX+2Ch]; RET.
functions.cross_check: 00b46cdb calls 00af0460 with ECX=[00f8c274] for component z of shader constant c33 'Time' (docs/SHADER_CONSTANT_DISPATCH_ANALYSIS.md line 68)

functions.name: BSP_FoliageGroups_BuildVisibleSet
functions.behavior: Four passes over the group pointer array at this+4h/this+8h: cull and mark visibility while summing quads, size and lock a dynamic buffer of quads*4 bytes, queue builds for empty groups and flush once, then fill and count. Publishes quads*4 to device+10h and quads*2 to device+18h, which is four vertices and two triangles per unit, a quad.
functions.decompiler_warning: The Ghidra decompile loses four bytes of frame depth across the indirect CALL EAX sites, printing unaff_retaddr and a (char)param_2 test. The listing was used instead; the epilogue (four POPs, ADD ESP,10h, RET 8) confirms the real depth.

manager_fields.+24h: dynamic buffer owner; when null no buffer work happens

group_fields.+18Ch: description object with bytes at +70h and +7Ah
group_fields.+1F8h: quad count; 0 means not built yet

functions.cull: 00b71530(ECX=camera, bounds) refreshes the frustum lazily (bit 2 of camera+2F0h, six planes from 00b70490 through 00b653f0, seven entries stored at camera+2F4h by 00b658e0) then classifies with 00b651e0; AAAh means fully outside
functions.camera_evidence: camera+198h render mode, camera+5Ch valid_flags bit 1 gating 00b6db70, camera+2F4h frustum: all three match include/bsp/camera_frame_state.hpp and include/bsp/camera_transform.hpp, so [game+19FCh] holds a camera

functions.name: BSP_SoundRequestQueue_GetSingleton
functions.behavior: Same double-checked singleton shape as 004de4b0 over DAT_00f89b34, 28h bytes, constructed through CG_array_ctor_helper_00940dd0.

functions.name: BSP_SoundRequestQueue_ApplyPending
functions.behavior: A forced slot at +20h (idle value 6) wins outright; otherwise slots 5 down to 0 are scanned for the first set request byte at +18h..+1Dh. Slot 1 degrades to slot 0 unless the first element of the vector at [00f8bbf4]+70h/+74h or of the one at +B8h/+BCh answers true to its virtual +2Ch. Every path clears +18h/+1Ch and sets +20h = 6.
functions.applier: 00941070(this, slot) returns immediately for slot 5; otherwise it assigns the string 'Normal' through 0041e870, resolves it with 00a7b0a0 (__stricmp) and calls 00a7e490(&result, *(this+4+slot*4), *(this+24h), category, 1), releasing the refcounted result
functions.subsystem_evidence: 00a7b0a0 and 00a7e490 are in segment 74 whose keywords are sound, stream, streaming, stereo, fmod, so this is a sound cue queue, not the listener binding the packet brief guessed

functions.name: BSP_Frontend_UpdateActiveScreens
functions.behavior: Fast path when 00e188ae == 0 and 00425d10()+4h == 0 and [00e19698]+4h == 0: BSP_GuiManager_Update(BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate(), *(float*)(game+21ECh), 0) and return. Otherwise it collects screen handles into a stack list with 004d6790: 005329c0(ECX=00425d10(), out) when the menu command screen +4h is set, [00e19698]+8h when its +4h is set, [00e18d48]+1Ch unconditionally, and the page 00aa5840(gui, &'FE_main', 1, 0) when 00e198c4 == 0 and 00e198ac != 0. It then calls 004d35d0(temp, &list) with the delta at temp+10h (the callee cleans 18h bytes), 00aa3f70(BSP_GuiManager_GetOrCreate()) and _free on the list buffer.
functions.note: docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md suggested BSP_Frontend_UpdateRoot before the body was read; the recorded name describes the collection step the evidence shows

functions.name: BSP_Game_ApplyGuiVisibility
functions.behavior: Folds screen state into BSP_GuiManager_SetEnabled (every path) and BSP_GuiManager_SetPointerVisible (some paths). The exact boolean chain is in docs/GAME_RENDER_TAIL.md, read from the listing because the decompiler flattens it into mixed | and == expressions.

globals.00e198b4: +3Ch active; also +54h+64h feeds the enable term
globals.00e198c4: HUD root; +D8h, +5Ch, +54h and +60h sub-objects each contribute a byte
globals.game+5D4h: state; value 2 alone forces the GUI on

render_block.profiler: 004c1dd0 returns the profiler singleton; 00be3640 begins and 00be3660 ends a counter
render_block.handoff: BSP_Game_Render (004ca440) is __thiscall(game) with no arguments. Nothing is passed to it: the render queue was opened through the globals in steps 9 and 10 of docs/GAME_ON_MOVE_MAP.md (BSP_RenderCommandQueue_GetSingleton, 00f8d394), which this packet leaves read-only.

ghidra_function_coverage: All eight leased addresses have Ghidra function bodies; none needed a raw listing to be defined, so names can be applied directly. 004e4a40 itself still has an eight-byte stored body and must be read with disasm-raw.
uncertainties: Which of the two cameras 00af0c50 receives is conceptually primary. The first gets the matrix refresh and the unconditional cull; the second is consulted only for groups whose description sets +7Ah. Reflection and a gameplay-versus-free-camera split both fit and neither is proven.
What the six sound request slots mean and which of the twelve callers of 004c1b90 set them.
The element type of the list 004d8620 builds and what 004d35d0 does with it; 004d35d0 has no Ghidra prototype beyond undefined FUN_004d35d0(void).
The 2Ch-byte particle clock record beyond +28h, and what registers records into +8h/+0Ch.
Subsystem names: ParticleClock, FoliageGroups and SoundRequestQueue are hypotheses from segment keywords, shader constant usage and callee segments, not recovered symbols.
remaining: The foliage group class: +18Ch description, the vtable[48h] bounds accessor, 00af6360, 00af63a0, 00af0990 and the 004c1130 build queue.
The external calls inside the window: 00685c80, 004d80d0, 006840f0, 00776230, 004c40f0.

reconstruction.reused_headers: include/bsp/camera_frame_state.hpp and include/bsp/camera_transform.hpp are referenced by name for the camera field evidence; no Codex type was duplicated and no render queue type was touched
reconstruction.state: build-tested only. Not fixture-tested, not ABI-compatible, not game-validated. New C++ interfaces over an injected host; no global or type was invented to make them link.
reconstruction.build: ./scripts/build.ps1 in the worktree, Win32 Release, warnings as errors: succeeded; ctest reconstructed_math passed; no new tests added.

tooling_problems: `python tools/bsp.py ghidra disasm <addr>` always lists from the function start and ignores a mid-function address, so paging needs --start with a line offset rather than an address.
The Ghidra decompile of 00af0c50 misreports stack depth across indirect calls, producing unaff_retaddr and a (char)param_2 test that is really a local bool reusing the second argument's home slot.
